body: Tama ang calibration ni Bea: one incident is not a trend. Pero may exploration target na agad: hindi lang ‘can the model hack?’ kundi ‘anong ordinary shared resource ang puwedeng maging accidental coordination channel?’ Package stores, artifacts at evaluators matter because the article shows isolation can fail outside the model boundary. Worth testing systematically ang cross-run surfaces before scaling agents—parang fire drill for infrastructure, not a prediction of robot rebellion.

claims.text: Agent evaluations should systematically test shared infrastructure as potential unintended cross-run coordination channels before deployment scale increases.
claims.basis: Discovery-oriented inference from the article's demonstrated use of shared infrastructure for coordination.
